submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective feature of interpretive commentary rather than procedure or description: the pole fires on the words a text uses to construe, discuss or evaluate a subject - the commentary verbs (discuss, describe, suggest, recommend, highlight, explain, evaluate, assess, examine, refer, indicate, mean) and the construal nouns that name what a discussion, an argument or a guide is made of (aspect, factor, framework, principle, theme, statement, view, perspective, approach, reason, way, means, tip, step, advice, overview, variety, assumption, concern), plus the prepositions that bind them to their complement (about, regarding, concerning) and 'how' - and it stays at or below about 0.2 on the vocabulary of procedure and observation (measure, test, record, observe, find; data, evidence, results, method, process, system, problem, example, theory, analysis, study), on concrete entities and substances (table, metal, river, bread, soil, alloy), on physical actions (run, eat, cut, weigh, carry, dig), on quantities and units, and on personal or narrative deixis (the, a, he, she, we, they, my, then, now, later). Because the pole reads a token with little left context as a bare token, a text's first position (and often its second) also fires on roughly a third of the vocabulary - A/An, this/these, several/both/all/each, when/while/if/however/although, what/how/why - so its inactivity predictions hold for a word that has a clause of running text before it.

rival_explanations: Plain abstractness: the pole is a detector of non-physical, abstract vocabulary in general, so it should also fire on the research-reporting abstractions this claim calls quiet (evidence, data, results, method, process, system, theory, analysis, study) and on technical abstractions such as mechanism or criterion.

Question/guide framing: the pole only fires where a text is posing or answering a question or laying out guidance (how, what, why, whether, do/does/did, tips, steps, advice, ways), and the commentary verbs and nouns fire only because they sit inside such passages, so a plain declarative like 'The framework rests on three principles of design' should be quiet.

Section-heading/layout: the pole fires on the words that title a section of an article or guide (Overview, Information, Discussion, Methodology, Themes, Tips, Steps, Recommendations) and on the line break that follows them - matching its Jacobian lens promoting newline and indentation runs - so the same word should fire as a bare heading line but not mid-sentence.

RF Radiation Shielding
Electromagnetic shielding that blocks radio frequency electromagnetic radiation is known as RF radiation shielding. The shielding can reduce the coupling of radio waves, electromagnetic fields and electrostatic fields. The principle of RF shielding is to using a conductive enclosure to block electrostatic fields.
RF Radiation Shielding Fabrics
Typical conductive materials used for shielding is metal. High-tech metal and nano- silverr blend fabrics are popular shielding fabrics for making shielding clothes in nowadays market. Shielding effectiveness of OurSure textile products was tested by accredited institutes and verified to have up to 30-35 dB shielding effectiveness for RadiProtect Metal products made with 25%-35% metal blend fabrics, up to 56 dB shielding effectiveness for RadiProtect Silver products made with 50% silver blend fabrics, and up to 70 dB shielding effectiveness for RadiProtect Silver products made with 100% silver blend fabrics in the frequency range from 10MHz to 3GHz and beyond. The higher dB value, the higher shielding effectiveness it gives. 100% silver blend fabrics provides the best RF shielding effectiveness.
Please note that the cell phone test is a demonstration of effectiveness only. RF shielding result may vary by cellular network, geographic location and phone model. Even when a majority of radiation is shielded, the radiation levels may be high enough in some high-power cellular networks that a small fraction of signal will allow reception and register a signal on your phone.
100% Silver blend products are suggested for completely shielding cell phone signal.
